Here in Mbeya the rains come reliably and maize does well, so I work this small plot carefully. I will buy a bag of CAN or DAP from the shop — even on 0.16 hectares it helps the yield, and I also spread what manure I can gather from the household. I use improved maize seed because neighbors who plant it get better cobs, and I intercrop with beans as always. I do not have money for pesticide and I depend on the rain — no irrigation here.
